content.short: Pieverse is a Web3 AI agent for chat apps that handles wallets, payments and invoicing in USDT.
content.description: Pieverse offers a Web3-native AI agent that works inside chat apps such as Line, Kakao and WhatsApp, handling wallet creation and custody and executing on-chain actions, alongside invoicing and payment apps for global transfers in USDT. Stable's official ecosystem page lists Pieverse.
